description: Generates the photos and videos of brief brief_id. Spends credits at the brief's quote. This client may show no approval prompt, so call it only when the user agreed in chat to run the brief: their message asking to generate or run it is that agreement, a request to change the brief is not one; otherwise give the quote and wait for their yes. expected_brief_revision and expected_total_credits must match the latest brief; if the quote changed, nothing runs and the new quote is returned. The same idempotency_key never runs or charges twice.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_brief_revision.description: brief.revision of the latest result for this brief; any other runs nothing.

expected_total_credits.description: quote.total_credits of the latest result for this brief; any other total runs nothing and returns the new quote.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key for one Generate, brief-{brief_id}-r{revision}: the same key never runs or charges twice.

name: confirm_brief
title: Generate Brief
